lead.tldr: iPhone exploit kit Coruna targets crypto wallets via fake sites stealing seed phrases. • Bitcoin ETFs see $462 million inflows as BTC price surpasses $73K. • Trump nominates pro-Bitcoin Kevin Warsh for Federal Reserve chair. • a16z crypto targets $2 billion fifth fund raise despite market downturn. • Western Union launches USDPT stablecoin on Solana boosting network momentum. • Kraken secures Fed master account enabling direct payment system access.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, US Bitcoin ETFs saw massive inflows as BTC topped $73K, while Trump nominated pro-Bitcoin Kevin Warsh for Fed Chair. Europol and FBI shut down a major cybercrime forum amid rising iPhone crypto scams, and a16z targets $2B for its next fund.

top_signals.title: Crypto Scams Using ‘Powerful’ iPhone Exploit Kit: Google
top_signals.summary: Google's Threat Intelligence Group uncovered the Coruna iOS exploit kit, a sophisticated tool with five exploit chains targeting iPhones on iOS 13.0 to 17.2.1, enabling remote code execution via malicious web content on scam crypto and gambling sites. This kit, originally from surveillance vendors and state actors like Russian spies targeting Ukrainians, now powers financially motivated crimes that steal cryptocurrency wallets, seed phrases, and apps such as Metamask. Institutional investors face elevated risks from these mass attacks on older iOS devices, underscoring the need for updated software, multi-layered defenses, and vigilant monitoring of mobile assets holding digital assets.

top_signals.title: US Bitcoin ETFs Post $462 Million Inflows as BTC Tops $73K
top_signals.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced $462 million in inflows, primarily driven by BlackRock's IBIT. This surge occurred as Bitcoin's price briefly exceeded $73,000, pushing most funds into positive territory year-to-date.

top_signals.title: Europol, FBI Wipe Major Crime Forum LeakBase Off The Web
top_signals.summary: Europol and the FBI have shut down LeakBase, a major cybercrime forum with over 142,000 members. The operation involved seizing user accounts, private messages, and financial data.

top_signals.title: Trump Sends Pro-Bitcoin Fed Chair Nomination to the Senate
top_signals.summary: Donald Trump has nominated Kevin Warsh, a known Bitcoin supporter, as the next chair of the US Federal Reserve. Warsh has made public statements supporting Bitcoin and cryptocurrencies.

top_signals.title: Exclusive: Venture giant a16z crypto targeting around $2 billion for its fifth fund amid blockchain market downturn, sources say
top_signals.summary: Venture capital firm a16z is reportedly targeting around $2 billion for its fifth crypto fund, despite the current downturn in the blockchain market. The firm, led by Chris Dixon, plans to close the fundraise in the first half of 2026.

top_signals.title: Andreessen Horowitz's Crypto Venture Arm Seeks $2B for Fifth Fund: Fortune
top_signals.summary: Andreessen Horowitz's crypto venture arm is seeking to raise $2 billion for its fifth fund, signaling a continued commitment to the crypto space despite current market conditions. This new fund indicates strong institutional interest in the long-term potential of crypto and Web3.

top_signals.title: Western Union launches USDPT on Solana: March rally for SOL?
top_signals.summary: Western Union is launching USDPT on Solana, potentially boosting SOL's price in March. This move indicates growing stablecoin momentum on the Solana network.

top_signals.title: Kraken Secures Federal Reserve Master Account: WSJ
top_signals.summary: Kraken Financial has reportedly obtained a Federal Reserve master account, granting them direct access to Fed payment systems. This allows Kraken to bypass traditional banking intermediaries for payment processing.

top_signals.title: Kraken wins Fed master account approval, a first for the crypto industry
top_signals.summary: Kraken's Wyoming-chartered banking unit has been granted a Federal Reserve master account, marking a first for a crypto firm. This approval allows Kraken direct access to the Fed's payment system.

top_signals.title: Kraken wins Federal Reserve Master Account in industry first
top_signals.summary: Kraken Financial has secured a limited-purpose master account with the Kansas City Fed, marking a significant milestone as the first crypto firm to achieve this. This regulatory approval could pave the way for greater integration of crypto firms into the traditional financial system.

At Blockwall, Europe's leading crypto VC focused on pre-seed and seed investments in blockchain, DeFi, and tokenized innovations, we track these dynamics to empower founders building the decentralized future. Google's Threat Intelligence Group recently exposed the Coruna iOS exploit kit, a powerful tool with five exploit chains targeting iPhones from iOS 13.0 to 17.2.1. Originally developed by surveillance vendors and state actors like Russian spies, it now fuels crypto scams on malicious web content from gambling and fraud sites. These attacks enable remote code execution to steal wallets, seed phrases, and apps like Metamask. For institutional investors, this highlights critical risks on older devices, demanding updated software, multi-layered security, and constant monitoring of mobile-held digital assets. On a brighter note, US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $462 million in inflows, led by BlackRock's IBIT, as BTC surged past $73,000 and turned most funds positive year-to-date. This capital momentum signals growing mainstream adoption and liquidity for the asset class we champion. Such crackdowns strengthen the ecosystem's integrity. As pioneers backing bold founders in Web3, these events reinforce our disciplined, long-term approach.
